mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 140,000 thousand persons indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 140,000 thousand persons.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.35% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary easing that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been below 0.35% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,100 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) above 440,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving multiplicative positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS has a negative coefficient or p-value > 0.05 in predicting 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 index points indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with INDPRO growth exceeding 105.0 index points.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,100 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST > 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% year-over-year and a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.4% indicates active monetary policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days; the effect is multiplicative.
failure_condition: The interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS has a positive coefficient or p-value > 0.05 in predicting 20-day SPX returns.
